categories.name: Scope and Definitions
categories.description: Defines the boundaries of the regulation, the types of financial data covered, the entities and persons subject to it, and foundational legal and technical terms.

categories.name: Data Access and Sharing Framework
categories.description: Core operational rules governing how financial data is accessed by customers and third parties, the duties of data holders, and the technical mechanisms enabling data sharing.

categories.name: Consent and Permissions
categories.description: Rules and procedures governing how customers grant, manage, and withdraw consent or permissions for access to their financial data by third parties.

categories.name: Accountability and Enforcement
categories.description: Allocation of liability across the data sharing chain, supervisory powers, penalties, cross-border coordination, and interplay with regulations like GDPR and PSD2.
